title: completion; settling

了 concerns completion or a matter being understood and settled. 完了 かんりょう is completion; 了解 りょうかい is understanding or acknowledgment. The character's contribution depends on the compound, rather than giving each word the same English translation.

title: settle; finish
済 is useful for something being settled, finished, or taken care of.

決 marks deciding or settling something.
[決める](../words/決める.md) (きめる) describes making the decision; 決まる (きまる) describes something becoming settled.

title: rule; follow a model
則 concerns a rule, standard, or following a model. 規則 きそく means rules or regulations; 原則 げんそく is a principle. 則る のっとる means to follow a rule, precedent, or model.

[倣う](../words/倣う.md) ならう means to follow an example or precedent;
[模倣](../words/模倣.md) もほう is imitation or copying.
title: standard, conform
準 concerns a standard, level, or conformity to a model. As the prefix 準 じゅん, it can mean semi-, quasi-, or associate rather than fully the named status.
１ 決まったルールにしたがう。よる。「循守・循吏／因循」

title: appropriate; settled

- [適](適.md) and [当](当.md) also express appropriateness; [正](正.md) includes what is proper or right, and [良](良.md) includes a satisfactory condition. These overlapping senses do not make their words interchangeable.
quiz_exclusions: [答, 承, 受, 適, 対]

The Daijisen character entry gives four senses: answering a question or call, as in 応答 おうとう, "reply; answer; response"; consenting; moving in response to an outside request or action, as in 応募 おうぼ, "application; entry," 反応 はんのう, "reaction; response," and 対応 たいおう, "dealing with; coping with; handling"; and being suitable or well matched, as in 相応 そうおう, "suitable; appropriate." The Daijisen heading also shows the older form 應, which this card does not teach.

- [答](答.md), "answer," [承](承.md), "accept; undertake," [受](受.md), "receive; undergo," [適](適.md), "suitable," and [対](対.md) each overlap a sense of 応: JMdict glosses 応える as "to respond; to answer," 応じる includes "to accept (an invitation, offer, etc.)," and 相応 is "suitable; appropriate." All of them are kept out of this card's quiz options. Do not treat "answer" or "accept" as exclusive to any one character.

title: gentle; superior

優 links several vocabulary families: kindness in [優しい](../words/優しい.md) やさしい,
excellence in 優れる すぐれる, and performers in 俳優 はいゆう.
The whole word tells you which meaning matters; a 優しい person is being described as kind, not ranked first.

- [順](順.md) includes sequence and obedience; [追](追.md) includes following, and [守](守.md) includes following a rule. [後](後.md) can express a position behind or a time after. These overlap particular following or sequential associations without making the words interchangeable.
- [回](回.md) includes revolving and [周](周.md) includes a circuit; these overlap the going-around sense of 循 without implying that every movement forms a cycle.

comparisons.reason: Repeat vs cycle

comparisons.reason: Ring or loop vs cycle

comparisons.reason: Sequence; next is following
comparisons.disposition: Harmless (medium): 次 locates the next item in a sequence (repo/kanji/次.md:20); 循 follow means follow a rule or course, not being next

comparisons.reason: Following on, forming a series (repo/kanji/続.md:20)
